id_contract.record: w<target_code>, zero-padded to the three digits the canonical id pattern requires
id_contract.sense: <record id>-s<n>, n = 1-based source order of the sense within the entry; a policy-excluded sense leaves a gap and is never renumbered
id_contract.sense_codes: every original sense_code in source order; the suffix n of a kept sense id indexes into it
id_contract.note: A loaded record keeps its id, shard and sense numbers; later shards take the remaining eligible target_codes in ascending order.
